## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Add coverage for adopting an already-matching setting. Recording that key is the behavior that distinguishes adoption from replacement.

## Changes

The settings merger now accepts `adopt=True`, records existing keys handled by that mode, and writes the configuration when it records changes. The pull request adds tests for updating a setting through adoption and replacement.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/config.py:13 — tests — Test adoption of an already-matching setting — No test exercises `adopt=True` when the stored and incoming values are both `theme=dark`. `test_adopt_updates_setting` starts with `theme=light`, which both modes update. — The suite would pass if adoption stopped recording matching keys and skipped the resulting configuration write.

## Suggestions

- app/config.py:18 — tests — Test that default merges preserve existing settings — No test merges incoming `theme=dark` over stored `theme=light` with both modes disabled. The default-mode test starts with an empty configuration and skips the replacement guard. — The suite would pass if a default merge started overwriting existing settings.
